The [[1961 West Chester Golden Rams football team]] compiled a 7–2 overall record during the regular season (4–0 in PSCC games) and won the East Division championship. The [[1961 Slippery Rock Rockets football team]] compiled at 6–2 overall record in the regular season (4–1 in PSCC games) and won the West Division title.
